name: feature-folders
description: The structure plugin of React Harness for projects without layers: a features/<name>/ module per domain area, an api/<resource>/ folder per backend resource, pages that only compose, plus global buckets. A skill answers local or global, a scaffolder creates a module, and a hook refuses a new file outside the structure, a wrong filename, or model content (a type, a constant, a schema, a hook, an HTTP call) in a UI file. Placement and naming block new files only, so a legacy project stays untouched.
